question: In which ritual modes does the group of five offerings beginning with foot-water apply?
premises: The group of five begins with foot-water.
The niṣkala mode is also included.
inference: This group of five offerings beginning with foot-water applies in both sakala and niṣkala modes.
uncertainties: The remaining four members of the group are not enumerated in this verse.
plain_english: This group of five offerings beginning with foot-water applies in both the sakala and niṣkala forms.
